### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, touching **16** documentable anchor(s).

**23** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json abb6df0e0109f32c8a51f94a4deaaa4518a0b5a2`.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **7** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json abb6df0e0109f32c8a51f94a4deaaa4518a0b5a2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `6ba79fd0acb60e24871c64d9e7346a947feb2485` — the merge of head `8944600e58305440f80d0448bb629ba558fc3847` into base `abb6df0e0109f32c8a51f94a4deaaa4518a0b5a2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 6ba79fd0acb60e24871c64d9e7346a947feb2485 && git checkout 6ba79fd0acb60e24871c64d9e7346a947feb2485
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin abb6df0e0109f32c8a51f94a4deaaa4518a0b5a2 8944600e58305440f80d0448bb629ba558fc3847 && git checkout -B drift-repro abb6df0e0109f32c8a51f94a4deaaa4518a0b5a2 && git merge --no-ff 8944600e58305440f80d0448bb629ba558fc3847

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json abb6df0e0109f32c8a51f94a4deaaa4518a0b5a2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs abb6df0e0109f32c8a51f94a4deaaa4518a0b5a2` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · ✅ ACCEPT: PR #23924 at `8944600e58` · `domain:engine` seat 2 · `session_01TQLy3Yq6vF4SDpTXdr3Uwi` · 2026-10-16T13:27Z

**Basis:** claim 6214846930 on #23852; the cross-lane declaration 6214854461 and its amendment 6216098114 on the `domain:services` seat post #21118 (no objection on either); the dev's report 6216061848; the seat's own reading of every non-generated hunk and of the tests' assertions, against `origin/main`.

**Checklist**
- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #23852`, `Clause-②: no` on its own line in the body and the changeset. No other number carries a closing verb.
- **`Clause-②: no` is truthful.** Metadata on six platform objects plus one action; no `packages/spec/src/**`, no field, index, permission or route change, no governed path. CI plus this in-seat read.
- **Scope.** 18 paths, all inside the claim surface or the amendment: the three identity objects' list views and one action, the three notification objects (one `all` view each, declared only for its `emptyState`, `columns: []`, no filter, sort or page size; amendment 6216098114 names the tab-label change), both packages' translation bundles, two new tests and one extended test, the changeset.
- **Item 2's own condition** ("the claimant confirms the route, and if a new door is needed, that half is its own question"): met with no new door. The seat read `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts` on `origin/main`: `POST /keys` pins `user_id` (and the active organization) to the caller and whitelists the body to `name` plus an optional `expires_at`. So the button can mint only for the person who presses it, on Setup's list as on the Account app's, and the changeset says exactly that ("the key is created for you").
- **One-shot reveal.** `two-factor-one-shot-reveal.test.ts`'s `ONE_SHOT_ROUTES` gains `/api/v1/keys: ['key']`, so every action on the mint route must reveal `key` once; ablation A2 (the reveal field removed) turns 2 tests red.
- **Translations.** `en` regenerated; the `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` leaves hand-written (AGENTS.md:712); the source-hash files have no net diff. The dev reports `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-coverage` exit 0.
- **Evidence.** `platform-objects` 1128 of 1128, `service-messaging` 584 of 584, typecheck exit 0, at the head after the merge of `origin/main`. Three ablations each went red and each restore was proven.
- **Changeset, sentence by sentence:** "What an admin saw" matches the console fallbacks the card quotes; "What changes" matches the diff, including "the data API still does not create keys" (the create affordance stays off); "Unchanged" matches (no field, index or permission hunk; the two row actions untouched). `patch` on both packages.
- **Gates on the head.** `ci-failure.mjs --pr 23924`: GREEN, 40 of 40. The six skips (`Console Pin Gate`, `Build Docs`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, the `Dogfood Regression Gate` matrix template, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`) are each on `check-expected-skips.mjs`'s roster, and each gate is unmet on this diff (no docs path, no `needs:pack-smoke` label, the full battery runs in the queue build).
- **Landing checks.** `check-governed-merges --pr 23924`: NOT governed, 904 changed lines. `mergeable_state` `clean`; `git merge-tree` against current `origin/main` (`11fea6b00`) is clean.

**The dev's deviations, accepted:** one `all` view per notification object (the claim's "the list views of" was false: there were none); the label "Create Key" (this object's title-case convention); the Subscriptions copy promises no delivery (the object records that subscriptions are not read at runtime).

**Out of scope, one line each (no card: none is a measured defect):**
- `sys_oauth_application`'s `active` view filters `disabled == false`; rows never toggled may hold NULL → `Acceptance notes` (read-only inference, not reproduced).
- `sys_api_key`'s header docblock says the raw token comes "via the auth plugin API"; the mint path is the runtime keys domain → comment drift, noted.
- `service-messaging`'s `ja-JP` / `es-ES` bundles echo English for the notification objects' labels (pre-existing) → noted.
- The docs name the Connect an Agent page and `POST /api/v1/keys` as the mint paths (`deployment/environment-variables.mdx:261`, `ai/connect-mcp.mdx`); none says they are the only ones, so the new button falsifies no page → noted.
